query: Texas 2026 Senate race general election polling Ken Paxton vs James Talarico, current polling average July 2026, RaceToTheWH tracker. What polls exist and who leads?

I've completed the research on the Texas 2026 Senate race. Here's the summary:

## Who Leads?
**A statistical dead heat** — the race is essentially tied as of late June/early July 2026, with no candidate leading outside the margin of error.

## RaceToTheWH Tracker & Other Aggregators
| Aggregator | Talarico (D) | Paxton (R) | Margin |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Race to the WH** (through Jun 28) | 45.5% | 45.0% | Talarico +0.5 |
| **270toWin** (Jun 1–28) | 45.4% | 45.0% | Talarico +0.4 |
| **RealClearPolitics** (Apr 22–Jun 27) | 44.6% | 45.2% | Paxton +0.6 |
| **Consensus** | 45.2% | 45.1% | Talarico +0.1 |

Talarico leads in 2 of 3 aggregators (including RaceToTheWH); RCP has Paxton slightly ahead. All differences are within statistical noise.

## Polls That Exist (8 since the May 26 GOP runoff)
Including the gold-standard **NYT/Siena poll (47–47 tie)**, UT/Texas Politics Project (Paxton +1), A2 Insights (Talarico +2), Texas A&M/ReconMR/Siena (tie), and others. Talarico's larger early post-primary leads (+7, +3 in May) compressed to a tie as the GOP consolidated behind Paxton after he ousted incumbent John Cornyn.

## Key Notes
- **Data vintage:** Most recent data is late June 2026. No new named statewide general-election poll appears published in early-to-mid July 2026, so the July picture reflects the late-June dead-heat.
- Rated a **toss-up** by Cook and RCP — the most competitive Texas Senate race in 30+ years.
- Talarico holds a ~5:1 fundraising edge; Paxton carries a -19 net favorability vs. Talarico's +7.
